capturedAt: 2026-09-02 09:45 MYT · Sep 1 US close / Sep 1 Malaysia close where verified
title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining business quality, plausible upside, downside/funding risk, valuation, technical location, current theme significance and portfolio overlap. Structural quality and buy-now quality are separate. Names without a fresh executable quote in this run explicitly require price refresh before action.
marketRegime: Oil/refined-product inflation and global long-end/real-yield stress are the immediate gate. AI physical infrastructure remains strong but now requires a funded-load / ghost-demand screen. Agriculture/fertilizer is strengthening but several leaders are extended after Sep 1. Gold remains structurally attractive but tactically weak below its 200-day trend.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price, business quality and current theme setup are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business/theme, but current price, tactical macro risk or portfolio overlap requires a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward or cyclical timing is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Theme may be attractive, but financing, valuation, dilution or execution risk currently dominates.
